text: aboutMessage uses one reloadTimeout to combine changes in the current event queue. The callback clears the handle before ReloadMessage, so later changes can schedule again. Preference, color-scheme and forced-color observers feed this route; unload removes those listeners and preference observers. Preserve the scheduling and teardown relationship; the selected source does not show an explicit unload cancellation for an already scheduled reload timer.
